text.en: Clients consistently commend Dr Fritz, Dr Hare, Dr Dowell, and their veterinary technicians for warmth and thorough care. Reviewers note that the team communicates empathetically during distressing situations and bereavement. While one client felt pressured regarding treatment costs and front-desk assistance, most owners report feeling supported.

title.en: Care for dogs, cats, and exotic animals

text.en: Pet owners praise the hospital for handling both traditional pets and unusual exotic companions, including rabbits and geckos. Reviewers highlight that pets appear relaxed during visits, with staff showing genuine enthusiasm for each animal. Longtime clients trust the clinic with surgical drop-offs and ongoing preventive wellness check-ups.

Reviewers report positive outcomes following surgical interventions such as mast cell tumour removals. Clients credit the veterinary team with accurate diagnostic assessments and effective healing plans that sustained pet vitality. Pet owners express confidence in the medical choices made for both routine and serious veterinary conditions.

q.en: Does Amici Pet Hospital treat exotic pets such as reptiles and rabbits?

a.en: Yes, clients specifically praise Dr Jake Hare for his veterinary care of rabbits and geckos.

q.en: Can pets undergo soft tissue surgery at this hospital?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report successful surgical procedures including tumour removals performed at the practice.

q.en: How do reviewers view the veterinary fees at Amici Pet Hospital?

a.en: Most clients consider the fees fair and transparent, though one reviewer noted concerns about booster vaccine costs.

q.en: Is parking readily available near the Little Italy clinic?

a.en: Reviewers do not mention dedicated parking lots, so visitors generally rely on neighbourhood street parking options.
